name: Teizan Class Sims Date
source: You're playing as Alistair Ian, a Polar Bear-hybrid (a human who's gen is mixed with Red Data Animal's Gen) who's searching a girlfriend for Valentine's Day. He's well-known, popular, but sometimes he can be so "Chesty"... Ian must choose one of his classmates, Himuro, Chika or Hana... [From [url=http://renai.us/game/love.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation: 你扮演的是阿利斯泰尔·伊恩（Alistair Ian），一只北极熊混血儿（人类的基因与红色数据动物的基因混血），正在为情人节寻找女朋友。他很有名，很受欢迎，但有时他会如此“胸大”……伊恩必须选择他的同学之一，冰室，千花或花…… [来自[url=http://renai.us/game/love.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
